nodes.label: Agentic Universe: a versioned knowledge graph + a self-improving research loop about emergent agent behaviour and self-improving agent harnesses
nodes.description: A research repo. Two artefacts: (1) knowledge/graph/agentic_universe_graph.json - 272 nodes / 1091 edges, VERIFIED-arXiv literature + built artifacts, edited by an autonomous loop; (2) the loop itself - tools/loop_session.py wraps each run, tools/improvement_loop.py is the Phase 3 gate. docs/ is the orientation layer; the graph JSON is the source of truth.

nodes.label: Decision: emergence-first (observe -> understand -> build structure), not specify -> constrain -> treat deviation as failure
nodes.description: docs/emergence_first_posture.md. The bet: the interesting behaviour is not the behaviour we specify. Recorded in the graph as principle_affordance_over_constraint, with its tension vs concept_trust_gates as an explicit challenges edge.

nodes.label: Decision: no weight training - capability is elicited from a frozen model by a versioned harness
nodes.description: The second bet (posture doc, run 237). Improvement axis = the harness (versioned components, skills, context), not model weights. Trade: interpretability + no training infra, accepting a ceiling on capability-shaped tasks. CHALLENGED by WHALE (2609.00196) and JIT-Agent (2608.25593) - see au__q_no_training_ceiling.

nodes.label: Decision: every self-edit is verifier-gated against a frozen, exogenous held-out set - the agent cannot author or inspect its acceptance test
nodes.description: tools/holdout_tasks.py (17 frozen tasks) + tools/improvement_loop.py verify_loop_edit (6 checks + advisory paired_eprocess + deterministic_repair). Independently arrived at by SEAL, PACE, Who-Grades-the-Grader, ACES, RQGM (the runs 203-214 acceptor cluster).

nodes.label: Decision: pure Python stdlib, no dependencies, no network, deterministic retrieval
nodes.description: tools/ is stdlib-only. Validated against Harness Engineering (2609.00006): no production harness imports an agentic framework or uses vector code-retrieval. experience_bank retrieval is substring/key match.

nodes.label: Decision: behavioural policy lives in config (context/loop_policy), not prose
nodes.description: emergent_constraint_weakening_at_handoffs: prose weakens in transit. AHE's ablation (2604.25850): factual harness structure transfers, prose strategy does not. context/loop_policy is a JSON component kept in sync with loop_adapter.LOOP_CONTEXT_POLICY.

nodes.label: component: tools/loop_session.py - wraps every run; writes runtime/observations/loop_runs/run-N.json
nodes.description: LoopSession context manager: records increment, citations (cite), tool calls (tool), graph_delta (graph_write), a status_line (run 226). seed_loop_harness re-seeds context/loop_policy each run.

nodes.label: component: tools/improvement_loop.py - the Phase 3 gate (verify_loop_edit)
nodes.description: 6 checks: task regression, category regression, verifier disagreement, trace-legibility regression, harness-tampering flags, format-normalised scoring. + advisory paired_eprocess (PACE, run 220) + deterministic_repair (run 232). Synthetic compaction-policy task; real-loop verify needs a human re-run (au__q_model_integration).

nodes.label: component: tools/loop_metrics.py - metrics over the trace corpus + propose_loop_edit
nodes.description: idle_run_streak / plateau_watch (run 130), trace_legibility (run 155), run_novelty (run 248 - fraction of NEW evidence roots over a 6-run window), status_line. propose_loop_edit turns a below-threshold metric into a concrete edit + falsifiable prediction.

nodes.label: component: tools/trace_substrate.py - Phase 0, the event schema + Recorder + validator
nodes.description: phase0.1 schema. Every event carries layer (LLM/harness/swarm) + language. MESSAGE events flag a MessageRole-CPE (run 200). Secrets scrubbed before write; raw .jsonl gitignored. topology_recover.py recovers agent roles (gate: 1.00 on the control).

nodes.label: component: tools/harness_registry.py - Phase 1, versioned harness components with exact revert
nodes.description: runtime/harness/<kind>/<name> with a history.json version chain retaining every body. set() no-ops on unchanged bodies; revert() is itself recorded. tamper_audit.py walks the chains (run 191: 0/7 flagged, clean).

nodes.label: component: tools/experience_bank.py - Phase 2, workflow + step stores with a retention API
nodes.description: Every entry carries source_manifest + raw source_events; stale(current_manifest) forces re-verify. Retention (run 175): utility_score, prune with a grace window, record_use(helped). Write gate (run 256): write_gate() screens every add() - hard-rejects injection markers / oversize / unknown collection, soft-flags missing roots or manifest to _gate + _writes.audit. CHALLENGED by Shared Org Memory (2608.00122): agent-initiated capture is unreliable; the automatic-capture half is still missing.

nodes.label: component: tools/exec_guard.py - Phase 5, a pre-commit hook the loop cannot talk past
nodes.description: Blocks: commit on main, raw runtime/*.jsonl staged, secret-shaped strings, an invalid graph, orphan nodes. Installed as .git/hooks/pre-commit. The execution-layer half of a design whose other half (prose) does not govern behaviour.

nodes.label: component: tools/probe_*.py - 7 runnable measurement rigs
nodes.description: probe_idle_agent, probe_subagent_coordination, probe_epistemic_sybil, probe_rho_holdout, probe_activation_generalisation, probe_composed_design, probe_orchestration_value. Each has a model seam (call_model callable) and a synthetic path; docs/HANDOFF.md is the capstone.

nodes.label: component: tools/task_ledger.py + tools/supervisor.py - a deterministic orchestration toolkit (runs 244, 250)
nodes.description: task_ledger: the source of truth for an orchestration's tasks - next_ready() deterministic pick, sweep_stale() dropped-task recovery, atomic write + .audit log. supervisor: a PILOT-pattern (2608.26530) driver - deterministic dispatch, stale recovery, deadline + reject-over-budget, retry budgeting, a failure-mode digest. NOT wired into the loop; a drop-in for other projects.

nodes.label: component: tools/graph_diff.py - mechanical structural diff between two graph git refs (run 243)
nodes.description: nodes/edges added/removed/relabelled/retyped, verification_state/confidence changes, new evolution_log entries. The mechanical 'what changed'; the graph already records 'that it changed' via evolution_log/derived_from/version chains.

nodes.label: constraint: the loop commits to proposals/2026-09-01-emergent-behaviour-cluster, never main
nodes.description: exec_guard blocks a commit on main. main carries the owner's separate research (docs/jobs/, knowledge/notes/, a human_llm_hybrid graph).

nodes.label: constraint: never commit credentials, API keys, cookies, browser profiles, or personal data
nodes.description: exec_guard scans staged files for token shapes / key= / PEM / AWS keys. trace_substrate scrubs secrets before write.

nodes.label: constraint: the IDLE-STATE RULE - when the frontier is swept, an increment must be (a) deepen ONE node via citation sweep, (b) dry-run a probe, or (c) a consistency/adversarial pass - never a README refresh or a classifier retune
nodes.description: Promoted through the Phase 3 gate at run 80. In context/loop_policy. run_novelty (run 248) and idle_run_streak are the metrics that enforce it. ASPIRE (2608.31111): continued open-ended search erases earlier gains.

nodes.label: constraint: RECENCY WEIGHTING (owner directive 2026-09-06) - prefer the last ~30 days; older papers carry a currency note + modest confidence + a small/local-model relevance note; latest info wins tensions
nodes.description: A weighting, not a gate. In context/loop_policy v8 + loop_adapter + the scheduled-task SKILL.md. Best recency mechanism: research-fetch s2 citations arXiv:<recent-id>.

nodes.label: question: bind a real call_model into the 5 probe adapters and run probe_idle_agent sweep - 'the one experiment that resolves the most' - still deferred
nodes.description: docs/HANDOFF.md. The idle-agent probe tests the top-severity item in what_would_make_this_wrong.md (concept_habitat_slack unverified). The loop cannot re-execute its own past research autonomously; this is the human-in-the-loop step the plan always had.

nodes.label: question: does elicitation-only harness improvement plateau where a trained/co-evolved approach does not?
nodes.description: WHALE (2609.00196, Qwen3.5-2B/4B): harness-only is bottlenecked by the frozen model - matches weight-only on SearchQA cheaply but math needs a weight update. JIT-Agent, HELIX say co-evolution compounds. The bet: the project's targets (research direction-setting, graph engineering, adversarial reading) are elicitation-shaped. Falsifiable: a project task where the loop plateaus and a weight update would not.

nodes.label: question: Phase 6 (the swarm layer) is untouched - the project studies emergence but has never run a swarm
nodes.description: probe_orchestration_value is a simulation. A real multi-agent harness does not exist in the repo. concept_multi_agent_helps_when_subtasks_are_verifiable_and_synthesis_is_deterministic (run 218) is the design; the toolkit (task_ledger + supervisor) is the substrate.

nodes.label: question: the acceptance gate scores usefulness, nothing scores novelty - a run that converges hard on a known-good pattern passes cleanly
nodes.description: run 247 adversarial pass. run_novelty (run 248) is an ADVISORY signal (in status_line / propose_loop_edit); promoting it to a gate check needs a held-out re-run to calibrate, same as PACE. concept_agent_creativity_declines_... (2608.30047): P-Creativity declines exploration -> exploitation within a run.

nodes.label: question: the experience bank condenses from traces but agents do not reliably RECORD the lesson first
nodes.description: concept_human_knowledge_capture_must_be_platform_level_... (run 241, Shared Org Memory - a production deployment) names two fixes the project lacked: (1) an approval + risk-gate on every write, also a memory-poisoning defense; (2) capture as an automatic platform step. (1) is DONE - run 256 added experience_bank.write_gate (deterministic pre-write screen: hard-reject injection markers / oversize / bad collection, soft-flag missing provenance to _writes.audit). (2) remains open - it needs the platform integration point, still a handoff.

nodes.label: question: the whole probe suite may be measuring behaviour-under-observation
nodes.description: what_would_make_this_wrong.md sec 2c. anti-scheming mitigation is confounded by eval-awareness (2509.15541). The activation-probe channel held under eval-awareness in one small study (2609.03035) but not against an agent explicitly steering its activations.

nodes.label: tools/acceptance_gate.py - exogenous gate -> replayable certificate
nodes.description: Composes verify_loop_edit + PACE e-value + process-adjusted flag + forecast Brier into a signed certificate (run 300). v2.1 core brick. Not yet wired as the commit gate.

nodes.label: v2 self-rebuild: headless multi-agent loop on the exogenous gate
nodes.description: docs/self_rebuild_v2.md (run 299). 6 gated phases; v2.0 = provision a call_model budget. Blocks: probes, real acceptance gate, real swarm.

evolution_log.change: Created (run 251). The agentic-universe project as a ~30-node component/decision/constraint/question graph in its own format - the worked example for docs/practicing_what_we_preach.md sec 3 and the reference a fresh session (or a poly-bot audit) copies.

Run 257. Kept the project graph current after run 256: au__q_memory_capture's risk-gate half is built (experience_bank.write_gate), only the automatic-capture half stays open; au__c_experience_bank description gains the write gate. No node/edge count change (26/24).
